== Course of events ==

After Glinda the Good's army is halted before the high, barred walls of the Emerald City, Glinda, Ozma, the Scarecrow, and a small guard fly the Gump into the palace courtyard and capture General Jinjur within her own seized capital. Confronted there, Jinjur refuses to surrender the throne she holds.

Rather than yield, General Jinjur declares war on Glinda the Good and Ozma, rejecting any peaceful end to the dispute over the Emerald City's crown. Her defiance marks the last stand of her rule, setting in motion the events that follow, including Tip's true identity coming to light and the eventual fall of her Army of Revolt.
